title: Destructive Action Modal
lede: Confirm destructive actions with a required type-to-confirm gate and an optional irreversibility band.

examples.heading: Default
examples.description: A type-to-confirm gate disables submit until the user types the verification phrase exactly. The red striped band at the bottom names what cannot be undone.

examples.heading: Reversible
examples.description: Omit `irreversibleDescription` for actions that can be re-enabled, undone, or rolled back. The type-to-confirm gate stays — the friction is still warranted — but the red band is skipped.

examples.heading: Loading
examples.description: `loading` disables both buttons and shows a spinner on the primary action. Use while the destructive API call is in flight. Caller controls `open`; don't dismiss the modal from inside.

examples.heading: With error
examples.description: Pass `error` (a string or an `Error`) to surface an inline error under the input. The modal stays open so the user can retry.

examples.heading: Open
examples.description: The modal open (a client-only state): the 480px panel with the title and description, the red band naming what cannot be undone, the prompt with the phrase and the empty verification input, and the footer with Cancel and the disabled red confirm.
